instrument: canvas rasterization at 8x supersample of each printable ASCII glyph, in the computed font of the live GitHub README code block (https://github.com/scores-patch-points/penelope, built-in browser pane); coverage = mean darkness over one character cell (cell width = measured advance of 'M', cell height = computed line height)

font.family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

colors.theme: light (data-color-mode=auto; the pane rendered light — dark theme NOT measured)

note: A different font or theme is a different instrument: re-measure, never reuse. Coverage is per glyph, not per pixel row; the extractor treats a band's ink as the mean coverage of its cells.
widthsMeasured: 2026-10-01 — DOM range widths of 20 repeats / the advance of M, in the GitHub code font; exactly 1.000 unless listed in nearOne.
